exec: Sophos's retail survey says data was encrypted in 62% of ransomware attacks on retail, up from 48% in 2025, while average recovery time fell to 2.54 weeks.
geo_basis: Sophos headquarters country; the report covers 17 countries
plain: Security firm Sophos says its survey found data was encrypted in 62% of ransomware attacks on retailers, up from 48% last year, while average recovery time fell to 2.54 weeks.

sources.name: Sophos: The state of ransomware in retail 2026

summary: Sophos's sixth annual retail ransomware report draws on insights from 217 IT and cybersecurity leaders across the retail sector in 17 countries. It says 62% of attacks on retail succeeded in encrypting data, up from 48% in 2025 and above the 56% cross-sector rate. Average time to fully recover fell to 2.54 weeks from 3.16 weeks, and exploited vulnerabilities started 26% of attacks.
title: Sophos survey: data encrypted in 62% of ransomware attacks on retail, up from 48%
